claims.head: St. Louis gets to the dangerous areas
claims.body: St. Louis ranks 6th of 32 for shot quality (one expected goal for every 15.0 unblocked shots); San Jose ranks 23rd for keeping shots to the outside.

claims.head: A low-event night is likely
claims.body: San Jose’s games average only 78.5 unblocked shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams combined (29th of 32 for pace); St. Louis’s average 78.5 (28th).

notes.text: L. Mailloux has not played this season. A. Jiricek is in his usual spot beside P. Broberg. That pair is getting 8:11 a game at 5-on-5, down from 11:56 with Mailloux.

STL.head: St. Louis should have the upper hand
STL.body: St. Louis has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. San Jose can make it interesting if its penalty kill holds up.

SJS.head: Not an easy night for San Jose
SJS.body: St. Louis has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. San Jose can pull it off if its penalty kill holds up.
